adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a bug in the logic. Looking at lines 1060-1068 in handleNewBooking.ts, when `eventType.destinationCalendar` is falsy AND `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` is also falsy, `evt.destinationCalendar` is set to `null`. Then at line 1074, `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` uses optional chaining, which means if `destinationCalendar` is `null`, the push operation is skipped entirely. The fix should initialize to an empty array `[]` instead of `null` when neither calendar exists.
